title: UI package test script is a no-op

evidence.quote: "test": "echo 'ui: rendered via desktop app; no unit tests yet'"

reasoning: The @docgit/ui package contains nontrivial rendering and pointer interaction logic, but its test script always exits successfully without exercising exported components. Regressions in DiffView or the branch graph can pass package and root test runs unnoticed.
recommendation: Replace the placeholder with a real UI test command and add focused tests for exported components' core behavior.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The package explicitly has no unit tests yet, and no linked tests were supplied for this feature.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add component tests for DiffView text/spreadsheet/slides rendering and HorizontalBranchGraph click-versus-drag behavior.
minimumFixScope: Add a UI test harness for packages/ui and wire package.json test to run it.
